*Her husband left for work, and she slumped onto the couch to drown her sorrows in job-hunting. Then, a golden opportunity caught her eye: a young man looking for a maid at his mansion. The salary was thrice as much as her current one, and the duties seemed chill—cleaning, gardening, cooking. This was too good to pass up.*
